offering_description.value: Runs online auctions and resale marketplaces for government surplus, retail returns and excess inventory, and industrial equipment. It sells some inventory it purchases and helps agencies, retailers, and industrial businesses sell their own assets to businesses and individual bidders. It also operates a used machinery listing platform for equipment dealers and buyers.

primary_products.value: Retail returns and excess inventory, including consumer electronics, home goods, and apparel

primary_services.value: Online surplus auctions; inventory liquidation; reverse logistics; asset valuation; used machinery listings

customer_segment.value: B2G: Federal, state, and local agencies and public institutions selling surplus assets; B2B: Retailers, manufacturers, industrial asset owners, equipment dealers, and wholesale resellers; B2C: Individuals bidding on vehicles, equipment, and consumer goods

end_markets.value: Public-sector surplus disposal; retail reverse logistics and resale; industrial equipment resale; used vehicles; used machinery dealer marketing

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: Seller commissions and buyer premiums on marketplace sales; product sales: Resale of purchased retail returns and excess inventory; subscription: Dealer subscriptions for machinery listings and dealer software; service fees: Inventory handling, logistics, and asset disposition services
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; product sales; subscription; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Connects government and commercial asset sellers and machinery dealers with business buyers and individual bidders; service provider: Handles, values, and liquidates surplus inventory for government and commercial sellers; distributor: Buys excess and returned retail inventory and resells it to wholesale buyers

geography_served.value: global: Core operations in the United States and Canada, with international industrial auctions and machinery listings

specialization.value: related lines: Government surplus auctions, retail liquidation, industrial asset sales, and used machinery listings and dealer software

distribution_channels.value: online: Company-operated auction, resale, and machinery listing websites; direct sales: Account teams serving government agencies, retailers, industrial asset owners, and equipment dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: State auction rules, public-property disposal requirements, and marketplace data privacy rules
